flagship.name: Egypt Photonics Conference
flagship.location: Cairo, Egypt (In-person and Hybrid Virtual Broadcast)
flagship.venue: Ain Shams University and The American University in Cairo (AUC)
flagship.description: The premier scientific meeting for optics, photonics, and quantum technologies across Egypt and the broader region. Bringing together university professors, doctoral researchers, international keynote speakers, and deep-tech industry leaders for three days of peer-reviewed technical sessions, workshops, poster presentations, and industrial technology exhibitions.
flagship.proceedings: All accepted and presented peer-reviewed papers will be published in the official Optica Egypt Conference Proceedings and Technical Digest with registered digital object identifiers (DOIs).
flagship.format: Three-Day Multi-Track Scientific Conference with Peer-Reviewed Oral Sessions and Interactive Poster Demonstrations

tracks.title: Integrated Silicon and Photonic Circuits (PIC)
tracks.scope: Design, automation, fabrication, and testing of integrated optical chips.
topics: Silicon and silicon nitride passive and active device architectures
High-speed electro-optic modulators and photodetector integration
Photonic packaging, optical fiber coupling, and edge couplers
Open-source process design kits (PDKs) and automated layout scripting

tracks.title: Optical Communications and Optical Computing
tracks.scope: Next-generation transmission, co-packaged optics, and optical accelerators.
topics: Co-packaged optics (CPO) and optical interconnects for artificial intelligence clusters
High-capacity optical fiber networks and wavelength-division multiplexing
Photonic neural networks, matrix-vector multipliers, and optical computing engines
Free-space optical communications, underwater telemetry, and satellite links

tracks.title: Laser Science, Quantum Technologies, and Nonlinear Optics
tracks.scope: Fundamental laser physics, nonlinear interactions, and quantum optical systems.
topics: Ultrafast lasers, micro-resonator frequency combs, and harmonic generation
On-chip single-photon sources, quantum key distribution (QKD), and entanglement
Nonlinear wave mixing, optical parametric oscillators, and soliton dynamics
Integrated quantum photonic circuits for metrology and quantum information

tracks.title: Optical MEMS, Sensors, and Applied Spectroscopy
tracks.scope: Miniaturized microsystems, spectroscopic instrumentation, and sensing.
topics: MEMS-based FTIR spectrometers and tunable Fabry-Perot micro-cavities
Photonic crystal refractive index sensors and lab-on-a-chip diagnostic devices
Environmental gas monitoring, industrial spectroscopy, and agritech photonics
Optofluidics, biomedical imaging, and point-of-care optical biosensors

tracks.title: Nanophotonics, Metasurfaces, and Plasmonics
tracks.scope: Sub-wavelength optical phenomena, flat optics, and structured materials.
topics: Dielectric metasurfaces for flat optics, beam steering, and polarization control
Plasmonic waveguiding, near-field optical microscopy, and sub-wavelength focusing
Two-dimensional materials in photonics (graphene, transition metal dichalcogenides)
Computational inverse design and topological photonics

registration.description: Standard registration covering publication of one accepted paper in proceedings, access to all technical sessions, lunches, and conference banquet.
Full author registration with proceedings publication, conference banquet, and one-year complimentary Optica local section affiliate membership.
Subsidized tier for undergraduate and graduate students presenting papers or posters, including career mentorship sessions and digital digest.
Two delegate passes, tabletop display booth in the technology pavilion, company logo in the program, and attendee directory inclusion.

authorGuidelines.pageLimit: Four to six pages in standard double-column IEEE / Optica conference format including figures, tables, and references.
authorGuidelines.peerReview: All submissions undergo rigorous double-blind peer review by at least three independent members of the Technical Program Committee.
authorGuidelines.templates: LaTeX and Microsoft Word templates will be made available upon Call for Papers launch.
